narration.full_text: Hello and welcome to our journey into the fascinating world of trigonometry! In this lesson, we'll unlock the secrets of trigonometric ratios, which are fundamental to understanding angles and sides in triangles. We'll start by defining what trigonometry is and why it's so important in various fields. Then, we'll dive into the core concept of trigonometric ratios, focusing on right-angled triangles. Get ready to explore how sine, cosine, and tangent, along with their reciprocals, help us describe these relationships. By the end, you'll have a solid foundation for solving problems involving angles and distances. Let's begin!
